name: Gay Marriage
overview: Scripture clearly defines marriage as a union between a man and a woman, established by God from the beginning of creation. Genesis 2:24 and Mark 10:6 affirm that this male-female relationship is the divine design for marriage. The Old Testament explicitly prohibits sexual relations between men, calling such acts abominations (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). While Christians are called to love their neighbors and treat others as they wish to be treated (Matthew 7:12; 22:39), biblical teaching maintains that marriage is exclusively between a man and a woman.
